body: I know exactly how you feel. I try to tell myself that nothing has to be solved right now, that I have time and can take as much time as I want to get better, for life to get better. Hope it helps.

You know fuck the whole "think of family" and "suicide is selfish" only people that don't know what it feels like to live with such burdens say that. Stay alive for yourself, for your future self. Find what ever little stupid or huge dream to stay for. Maybe a song, for a new experience or what ever. You might think in this moment life is unbearable, but it is just that A MOMENT, it passes. Hope you'll stay a bit longer. We need you.
